detail-headline.purpose: Title first on the full detail page.

body.purpose: Content and inherited control text; adapts to Silo readability settings.

shadows.name: notice
shadows.purpose: Separates transient notices from the current surface.

motion.name: platform-hover
motion.purpose: Lifts platform artwork only without a reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: cover-hover
motion.purpose: The later source rule lifts game covers only without a reduced-motion preference.

elevation.name: dialog-backdrop
elevation.purpose: Separates account, controller-choice and pause dialogs from the page.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The principal sign-in or play action, using Silo’s inverse pair.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:var(--font-body, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:16px;font-weight:650;padding:10px 15px;border:1px solid var(--border,#28282e);border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent,#e8e8ec);color:var(--on-accent,#141417);cursor:pointer}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--accent,#e8e8ec)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:4px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:var(--font-body, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:16px;padding:10px 15px;border:1px solid var(--border,#28282e);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel,#1c1c20);color:var(--text,#e8e8ec);cursor:pointer}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--panel-2,#232328)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:4px}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}

components.name: Text action
components.description: Quiet back and breadcrumb actions retain an explicit word label.

components.name: Gallery search
components.description: A persistent compact label sits above the gallery search field.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Search games<input type="search" placeholder="Search games in this library"></label>

components.name: Library rail
components.description: Searchable platform navigation uses open rows and a semantic current destination.
components.css: .ds-rail{font-family:var(--font-body,"Plus Jakarta Sans",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif);width:210px;background:var(--rail,#0f0f12);color:var(--text,#e8e8ec);padding:24px 14px;border-right:1px solid var(--border,#28282e)}.ds-rail button{font:inherit;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;width:100%;min-height:42px;padding:10px;border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:7px;text-align:left;font-size:.8125rem;line-height:1.45;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-rail button:hover,.ds-rail button[aria-current]{background:var(--panel-2,#232328)}.ds-rail button[aria-current]{font-weight:650;color:var(--accent,#e8e8ec)}.ds-rail button span{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-rail small{font-size:.6875rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted,#a4a4ae)}.ds-rail .ds-platform-icon{width:24px;height:24px;flex:0 0 auto}.ds-rail .ds-icon{width:20px;height:20px;flex:0 0 auto}.ds-rail-search input{font-family:var(--font-body,"Plus Jakarta Sans",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif);width:100%;font-size:.75rem;border:0;padding:8px 0;margin:14px 4px;background:transparent;color:inherit}.ds-rail button:focus-visible,.ds-rail-search input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Illustrated platform tile
components.description: The actual bundled platform illustration sits on a landscape tonal ground.

components.name: Illustrated game fallback
components.description: A missing cover keeps portrait geometry with a platform illustration and title.

components.name: Playable filter
components.description: A native checkbox and explicit label keep the positive play filter legible.

components.name: Controller choices
components.description: Stacked choices make filtering operable without a native select popup.
components.css: .ds-choices{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font-family:var(--font-body, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-choices button{font:inherit;text-align:left;min-height:44px;padding:10px 15px;border:1px solid var(--border,#28282e);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel,#1c1c20);color:var(--text,#e8e8ec);cursor:pointer}.ds-choices button:hover{background:var(--panel-2,#232328)}.ds-choices button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--text,#e8e8ec);color:var(--panel,#1c1c20)}.ds-choices button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
RomM presents a platform-first personal games library within Silo's existing visual language. A searchable navigation rail and illustrated platform overview help you choose a system or Play in Silo before browsing covers, opening a full detail page, and playing or resuming a game. Genuine game artwork and bundled RomM platform illustrations supply the character; the surrounding interface stays calm, familiar and content-led.

Dark and light themes share the same geometry and bundled typography. Compact controls, explicit state text and visible focus support keyboard, touch and controller access. The player keeps this control language while giving the game the remaining viewport.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic Silo colors with coherent dark and light fallbacks.
One bundled type family for headings, content and controls.
A searchable platform rail, illustrated platform tiles and cover-led galleries.
Title-led full detail pages, labeled controls and explicit play or progress states.

rules.name: The Theme Alias Rule
rules.body: Reuse the existing semantic aliases so foreground, background and borders change as a coherent theme.

rules.name: The Title First Rule
rules.body: In a game detail, the title precedes normal platform metadata. Platform information is not an uppercase kicker above the heading.

rules.name: The Flat Control Rule
rules.body: Preserve tonal hover states and the visible focus outline; ordinary buttons do not need ornamental shadows.

dos: Do use Silo's semantic color aliases and bundled Plus Jakarta Sans.
Do use the bundled RomM platform illustrations consistently across navigation, overview and cover fallbacks.
Do keep platform tiles landscape and game covers portrait, with readable titles below the artwork.
Do keep the game title before platform metadata on the detail page.
Do preserve explicit labels, semantic selected states and visible keyboard focus.
Do keep the game stage dominant and progress text visible.
donts: Don't introduce a competing decorative palette or display face.
Don't replace the illustrated title fallback with an oversized initial.
Don't turn a game detail into an account-style modal.
Don't promote platform metadata into an uppercase eyebrow.
Don't communicate error, selection or pending progress through color alone.
